why: The fix's inter-CPU delivery hook up_send_smp_call is implemented only in arch/arm64/src/common/arm64_gicv3.c (SGI3 IPI) and requires CONFIG_SMP plus multiple CPUs; the PR and its discussion only validate on qemu-armv8a:nsh_smp, and arch/sim has no such implementation, so smp_call_test cannot run on sim:nsh.
reason: Kernel PR 10934 adds CONFIG_SMP_CALL and nxsched_smp_call*/up_send_smp_call, and apps PR 2137 adds the detecting smp_call_test (registered in ostest_main.c under #ifdef CONFIG_SMP_CALL, which would compile-fail against the old kernel and assert-fail at runtime without the fix). But the only per-architecture implementation of the required hook up_send_smp_call is in arch/arm64/src/common/arm64_gicv3.c; grep at head finds no implementation in arch/sim or generic code, and sim:nsh is single-CPU with no IPI/SGI path, so the test cannot run on the only supported target. The PRs themselves only validated on qemu-armv8a:nsh_smp.
